steps.name: run-stage14g-residual-data-scaling-probe-fixed-v2
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=34d164cd7b5a68ed7b46228e7aef8539c7539c6e; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage14/stage14d_residual_intervention_audit.py > /tmp/stage14d-residual-intervention-audit.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage14/stage14f_per_output_residual_ablation.py > /tmp/stage14f-per-output-residual-ablation.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage14/stage14g_residual_data_scaling_probe.py > /tmp/stage14g-residual-data-scaling-probe.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/stage14g-residual-data-scaling-probe.py')
s = p.read_text()
needle = 'TRAIN_SCENARIOS_PER_FAMILY = 8'
if needle not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected Stage 14G scenario-count constant not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(needle, 'TRAIN_SCENARIOS_PER_FAMILY = 6', 1))
PY
.venv/bin/python -m py_compile /tmp/stage14d-residual-intervention-audit.py /tmp/stage14f-per-output-residual-ablation.py /tmp/stage14g-residual-data-scaling-probe.py; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python /tmp/stage14g-residual-data-scaling-probe.py; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
